description.zh:
消息ID。

调用Push接口，设置Target为TBD，调用后获得的MessageId。它代表了一个已经保存到推送系统的消息。
description.en:
The message ID.

This ID is returned after you call the Push operation and set Target to TBD. It identifies a message saved in the push system.

descriptions.zh: 若不调用此接口以手动形式结束持续推送任务，持续推送任务将会在到达过期时间时自动结束。
descriptions.en: If you do not call this operation, the continuous push task automatically ends when it reaches its time-to-live (TTL).
